title: Retrospective Analysis of Brachytherapy and Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy in Patients with Cholangiocarcinoma
summary: Retrospektive Auswertung von Sicherheit, Wirksamkeit und Durchführbarkeit einer Brachytherapie bzw. SBRT bei Patienten mit cholangiozellulärem Karzinom.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm: Intrahepatic bile duct carcinoma

interventions.name: Patients who underwent brachytherapy or stereotactic body radiotherapy for cholangiocarcinoma.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Histologically or radiologically confirmed cholangiocarcinoma
Received brachytherapy or stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT)
Exclusion criteria:
Age < 18 years
no additional exclusion criteria
